radiation.title: Solar particle event in progress
steps: Stop current task and secure equipment
Move to the shielded crew quarters
Stay until the dose rate is back in the normal band

heart.title: Heart readings above your baseline
steps: Stop exercise and rest for 10 minutes
Report chest pain or dizziness immediately

bone.title: Exercise is well below your plan
steps: Report any pain that is stopping you from exercising

mind.title: Sleep and mood have dropped
steps: Move one task off today's schedule
Request a private call with the flight surgeon
